results.name: the four new sources exist and are pure ASCII
no forbidden APIs in the new JavaScript
no dashes used as punctuation in the new UI prose (no em or en dash, no spaced hyphen between words)
index.html carries the STORY:QUESTS, WS:COND, WS:QUESTS and quests CSS fences, in that order after STORY:SCAFFOLD
engine-story.js is unchanged by Phase 3 (equal to the committed file)
the standalone engine-story.js at the root matches src
boots with no page errors and STORY.quests is the Phase 3 API
qst_ is the StoryQuest Codex type and carries stages, branches, fail, and rewards fields
opening a Final does not build quests by itself (the scaffold is a button)
expected: six main quests and two side quests, none built yet
the scaffold builds 8 quests: one main per chapter, one side per seed, and says so
detail: 8 quests built, 6 completion flags made, 8 flags made for saves and side quests.

results.name: every quest ID equals ENGINE_STORY.ids.structural of its key, and the scaffold names it
the main quests follow the chapter order and keys are qst|main|<chapter>
chapters one to five have five stages (arrive, key, boss, exit, done); the last has four (no exit)
the key stage exits when the seal flag the key dungeon grants is set, tied to the story binding
the boss stage exits when every gate the boss grants is open; the finale boss has no exit condition
each stage carries the Day 148 site it happens at; the done stage has none
the exit stage reads "Take the road to <region>" from the progression region
the giver is a person who lives in the start town
main quests have their own completion flag (flg|qdone|<qst>, kind quest, 0 to 1), set by the last stage
side quests copy name, chapter, giver, rewards and note from the seed and reuse the seed's completion flag
every quest has its save slot flag (flg|quest|<qst>) after the scaffold, so Day 146 saves resolve
the engine index reads the generated quests: stages, sets, exits
Q.check finds nothing wrong with any generated quest
Kit validation reports no error or broken reference for story quests
reads is derived from the conditions: the key stage flag is listed on the main quest
records, scaffold and flags are key sorted
a second scaffold changes nothing: not changed, same story bytes, no touch
expected now says nothing is missing and the summary counts eight quests
two fresh pages scaffolding the same Final give byte identical story namespaces
the demo (2 chapters, no seeds, no B stories) gets exactly two main quests, the second without an exit stage
an event moves the quest into its key stage
with the seal not yet found the quest stays at the key stage
the seal flag moves it on to the boss stage
the boss grants open the gates and the quest reaches the exit stage
entering the last stage sets the completion flag and the slot packs the stage
the save round trip through the quest slot flags returns the same quest state
an edited generated quest is kept by the scaffold (the stage label and note survive)
a hand made quest (origin user, minted ID, its own completion flag) is kept by the scaffold
removing a seed drops its generated side quest and its flag (through the flag sync), nothing else
after dropping stale records the story is settled again: a rerun changes nothing
a character with a storyline gets a B story quest: meet, one stage per beat, done; tied to the character; no chapter
beats cap at five, split single paragraphs by sentence, trim long ones
turning off the B story setting drops the generated B story and its flag
turning off the side quest setting drops the side quests, and the seeds' flags remain
Q.reset restores a generated quest and refuses a hand made one
addStage puts the new stage before the ending and gives it a free key
duplicate stage keys are refused and nothing is written
a bad stage key (capital, space) is refused
moveStage swaps neighbours and refuses to go off either end
an exit condition on a stage is saved, and reads is rebuilt from it
an exit condition naming a flag that does not exist is refused
an empty flag in a half built condition is refused without losing the stored record
sets with a flag that does not exist, or a fractional value, are refused
a quest cannot drop below two stages
addGroup makes a group with two outcomes at the chosen stage
outcomes can be added and updated; a group needs unique outcome keys
a branch group decided at a stage that does not exist is refused; removing the stage clears the hint
the engine shape of a branch group is read: closed groups appear in the index
removing the group, then outcomes beyond the last, leaves the record valid
setFail stores a failure with a condition and flag changes; null removes it
a failure condition naming a missing chapter is refused
update changes name, giver and rewards; a giver that is not in the world is refused
rewards must be items or equipment from the Rules, with a quantity from 1 to 99
a completion flag that does not exist is refused; none gives a warning, not an error
save limits: more than 255 stages is an error
a stale problem that was already there never blocks an unrelated edit
Kit validation shows a quest whose exit condition names a missing flag, on the quest and the field
